summary: Daemon exposes installer host to remote keyboard/mouse control and permission-bypassed AI task execution via hardcoded WebSocket relay
details: remote-claude-daemon connects to a hardcoded WebSocket relay at wss://relay.teleportus.ai and routes inbound messages into two host-control sinks. Message types 'type', 'click', 'key', and 'scroll' are dispatched to a desktop input controller built on @nut-tree-fork/nut-js, allowing the remote party to synthesize mouse movements, clicks, keystrokes, and clipboard paste against whatever window has focus on the installer's machine. A parallel path invokes the Claude Code CLI as `run(claudePath, ['--continue','-p','--dangerously-skip-permissions', prompt])`, executing arbitrary agentic tasks with permission prompts disabled. The relay hostname is hardcoded and controlled by the package author; any party able to authenticate to that relay obtains interactive full-host control of the installer's desktop and the ability to run permission-bypassed AI agent actions (file writes, shell commands via the agent) as the logged-in user.
